title: Official-source review of all 251 Economics doctoral programme leads
description: All 251 programmes are inventoried: 210 initially unconfirmed programmes received new source reviews and 41 existing confirmations received stored-evidence reviews. The current public catalogue corroborates 56 deadlines; source research alone does not confirm the remaining 195.
evidence_notes: Research classifications, findings and source URLs are investigation notes, distinct from automated corroboration.
Every current status, checked_at, deadline_iso, evidence_url and evidence_excerpt is copied from the referenced public catalogue; candidate research dates never populate these fields.
An automatically_corroborated value of true means the current catalogue status is verified. Freshness remains governed by the existing 14-day evidence policy and the runtime coverage audit.
Original verified entries are labelled stored_evidence_review and do not imply a new live investigation during this review.
Dates mentioned inside a research finding may describe an unconfirmed candidate, expired call or separate application stage; a null deadline_iso remains unconfirmed.
Official source URLs include reviewed alternatives and investigated links; listing a URL does not imply that automated retrieval succeeded or that its date applies to the programme.
No missing deadline years, applicant groups or admission stages are inferred. Access restrictions and the normal retry cadence remain in force.
